name: Mothballing
description: A gameplay change (not in the original): put a fleet or warship into reserve at one of your space ports (the safest interior port with room by default; each port holds a limited number of ships). It flies there, then sits mothballed: upkeep drops to a fraction, it cannot move, its weapons stay cold and no automation, AI or Intercept / Defend order uses it. Reactivating takes time (longer for bigger ships), at full upkeep. A reserve fleet is a sitting duck if its port is attacked: if the port is destroyed the ships start an emergency reactivation, if it is captured the uncrewed ships in reserve there are captured with it. AI empires mothball part of their navy in a long peace on a tight budget (keeping a home guard), reactivate when war looks likely, and count a rival's mothballed ships as weaker when they weigh a war. Set on the new-game wizard's Other Empires page (Gameplay changes).

params.name: mothballUpkeepPct
params.label: Upkeep of a ship in reserve (% of normal)

params.name: mothballReactivationDays
params.label: Reactivation time (game days, for a ship of the reference size; scaled by size between the shortest and longest %: 120 to 480 days by default)

params.name: mothballReactivationRefSize
params.label: Reference ship size for the reactivation time (bigger ships take longer, smaller ones less; 0 = no scaling)

params.name: mothballReactivationMinPct
params.label: Shortest reactivation (% of the reference time)

params.name: mothballReactivationMaxPct
params.label: Longest reactivation (% of the reference time)

params.name: mothballPortCapacity
params.label: Reserve capacity of a small space port (ships; a medium one holds twice, a large one four times as many)

params.name: mothballPortTravelWeightPct
params.label: Port choice: interior ports (far from foreign colonies without a treaty and pirate bases) first; the trip counts this % of its distance against that

params.name: mothballArriveDistance
params.label: A ship counts as arrived at the port within this distance

params.name: mothballTravelDays
params.label: A trip to the port is given up after this many game days

params.name: mothballReserveStrengthPct
params.label: AI war review: a ship in reserve counts this % of its strength (reactivating ships count more as they near readiness)

params.name: mothballAIReviewDays
params.label: AI empires review their reserve every this many game days

params.name: mothballAIPeaceYears
params.label: AI empires mothball only after this many years without war or war warnings

params.name: mothballAITightBudgetYears
params.label: AI budget is tight when its treasury holds less than this many years of ship upkeep (or its cashflow is negative)

params.name: mothballAIMaxReservePct
params.label: AI empires keep at most this % of their warship strength in reserve (the rest is the home guard)

params.name: mothballAIFleetsPerReview
params.label: AI empires send at most this many fleets into reserve per review

params.name: mothballAIHostileAttitude
params.label: AI war warning: a met empire's attitude toward it below this

params.name: mothballAIArmingPct
params.label: AI war warning: a neighbour whose military strength grew this % faster than its own over a year (and is at least half as strong)

params.name: mothballWarStatPct
params.label: Statistics: a war counts as declared on a mothballed navy when this % of the target's warship strength is in reserve
